title: Penalty Basis Tariff — Room Reservations Late Cancellations and No-Shows
content:
Each Room Reservations rate plan names a penalty basis for a cancellation recorded after the effective deadline and a penalty basis for a reservation marked a no-show, states whether the nights after the first are released without charge on a no-show, and states whether room and occupancy tax is added to a cash penalty.

| Rate plan | Late cancellation basis | No-show basis | Nights after the first released on a no-show | Tax added to a cash penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | Full stay room and tax | Full stay room and tax | No | Yes |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Flexible Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Member Flexible Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Group Block Rate | First night room and tax | First night room and tax | Yes | Yes |
| Reward Night Rate | First night points | First night points | Yes | No |

## The three bases

| Basis | What it names |
|---|---|
| First night room and tax | one night of the stay, as a cash penalty |
| Full stay room and tax | every night of the stay, as a cash penalty |
| First night points | the points or Free Night Award paying the first night; no cash penalty |

## Notes on the tariff

- The Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate is the only plan whose bases are the full stay, and the only plan that does not release the nights after the first on a no-show.
- The Reward Night Rate is the only plan whose bases are first night points, and the only plan that does not add tax to a penalty.
- On every plan the late cancellation basis and the no-show basis are the same basis.
